about: Nine brand-only Norspan supplies of two weekly patches every 14 days cover 126 consecutive days including the final supply.
Seven monthly OxyContin supplies of 56 tablets taken one tablet twice daily cover 196 days including the final supply and excluding the short gaps between refills.

Two OxyContin supplies on 4 August and 1 September 2026 (28 days between dispense dates, 56 tablets taken twice daily each) cover 8 weeks (56 days) of treatment, which is less than 3 months and does not meet the duration rule.
